capabilities_done: slice1: MediaProvider port, Registry (instance-owned, enumerable, detect, proxy/original arbitration), ISOBMFF/MOV index + frame-accurate seek + packet delivery, WAV, Y4M, observe report, typed MEDIA_* errors

slice2 PCM-in-MOV: twos/sowt/in24/in32/fl32/fl64/raw/lpcm(v2) sound descriptions verified against Apple QTFF pages + FFmpeg mov.c/isom_tags.c; regular PCM tracks stay compact chunk runs (never one entry per audio frame, proven under max_samples=100 with 5000 frames); bounded LE slices across chunk runs; exact tick timing; one non-empty edit + leading empty edits; irregular/odd cases typed Unsupported (lpcm non-interleaved/unpacked, multi-edit, non-frame-aligned edit); compressed audio entries = CodecUnavailable naming FourCC while packets still demux

slice2 tmcd: TimecodeDescription (drop/24h/negative/counter flags verified vs Apple page, timescale, frame duration, fps), tref/tmcd link, read_timecode_start -> raw 32-bit sample + signed frame_number + pts; NO label formatting

slice2 fMP4: mvex/trex, moof/mfhd/traf/tfhd/tfdt/trun (flag masks verified vs Bento4 headers), data-offset base rules (explicit base, default-base-is-moof, first-traf moof start, previous-traf end), first-sample-flags, non-sync bit 0x10000, tfdt or continuation DTS, sidx v0/v1 with absolute offsets, truncated_tail flag, sample budget checked before allocation, same exact-PTS + seek + packet rules
slice2 IndexCache: keyed (content id, revision, length, limits), LRU capacity <= 64, new revision drops older entries, hit still verifies grant (StaleGrant), decode_cached(), approx_bytes stats

tests.foundation_contract: PASS 5/5 (slice 1; one expectation changed: moof before moov is now 'moof-before-moov')
tests.tree: shared edit tree at 039fbee; not an export of the pushed SHA; workspace-probe not run by builder

known_gaps: fMP4: legacy 'previous traf end' base rule implemented per ISO but untested (fixture has one traf per moof); multi-description tracks, trun version-0 composition offsets read as signed (same convention as progressive ctts)
tmcd counter-mode / legacy timecode-record sample interpretation not applied: raw_sample is authoritative
PCM: packets output of compact PCM tracks is Unsupported by design; PCM with edit lists beyond one real edit is Unsupported
compressed codecs, MXF, Matroska, relink remain out (STU-VID-084 licence decision)
deps: none beyond accord + observe (path); no dep-requests entry
next: validator round on 039fbee (slice2_contract and foundation_contract). Candidate next slices: Matroska/WebM own EBML demux index; MXF OP1a index; sampled-identity source hash + relink; PCM 'packets' view for compact tracks; AIFF/CAF PCM providers; ProRes/DNxHR pure decoders after VID-084

decisions.text: NO reel->pulse edge; module map keeps reel on accord+observe. Reel exposes raw tmcd fields (TimecodeDescription, TimecodeStart); consumers (session/interop-media) format labels with pulse.
